blocks.text: At Nightshade Cocktails & Spirits, the drinks may be carefully crafted, but the experience begins somewhere simpler: with good company. “Connections first, drinks later,” says Jet Javier, co-founder of Nightshade Cocktails & Spirits. “We want Nightshade Cocktails & Spirits to be a place where people can come together, have good conversations, and feel comfortable enough to stay a little longer.” That philosophy shapes the new cocktail destination at The Shoppes at McKinley West, where Nightshade Cocktails & Spirits strikes a balance between a relaxed neighborhood drinking spot and a more serious cocktail bar.
